My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

translations.web: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
translations.bsb: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
translations.kjv: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
translations.asv: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath seen my desire upon mine enemies. Psalm 55 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David.
